遗址开启，震惊世人（遗址开启，震惊世人（第22页）分身的残影都还残留在外面那一方空间内，外面就传来轰的一声响，却是一只炼尸已经感知到那分身要逃窜，所以骤然提速，轰然落在地面之上。
“蝴蝶假面，你难道还真非得要拼个鱼死网破吗？”
可惜，这舍命断后的盗贼强者，拖延时间却实在有限，只短短数秒过去，便一声‘身不由己’死前惨叫的挂倒光去。
吴非拿起药丸，千里眼大开，但他发现这枚丹药，居然炼制的时候加了三层外皮，这要让人鉴别，简直是难上加难。
慧敏长老道：“不信是你的事，反正长老会已经给他记了大功，只要他回来，就可以得到奖励。”
慧敏长老这么说，忽然觉得不远处有人朝她投来狠狠的一瞥，一转头，发现是介素真人，不禁一怔。
“姐，今天平安夜，你和我龙哥今天有啥安排吗？”
林萧心里的八卦因子又活跃了起来。
当然，这个世界对于白夜又没有恶意没有人知道，但是薙切绘里奈确实真真实实的感受到了来自白夜的恶意。
夜来到了隔壁的二班的教室，他发现二班的教室和自己班上的教室几乎是一模一样，同样的，当夜祭观察脚印的时候，那个怪物也是突然出现在后门，然后在教室里面转了一圈之后，又消失在了后门外面。
林思语心头一跳，下意识的就松了手，反应过来后，杜亦龙已经毫不停留的大步走远了。
昺夜大祭司眼露出复杂的神色，他缓缓道：“好吧，那我给你一次机会！”

Chapter 221 The opening of the ruins shocked the world (page 1)
The ruins were opened, shocking the world (the ruins were opened, shocking the world (page 22)) The afterimage of the clone still remained in the space outside. There was a bang from outside, but a zombie had sensed that the clone was about to escape, so it suddenly accelerated and landed on the ground.
"Butterfly Mask, do you really have to fight to the death?"
It's a pity that this strong thief who risked his life had a limited time to delay. Only a few seconds passed before he screamed "involuntarily" before dying.
Wu Fei picked up the pill, his clairvoyance widened, but he discovered that this pill actually had three layers of skin added during refining, which made it extremely difficult for people to identify it.
Elder Huimin said: "It's your fault if you don't believe it. Anyway, the Presbyterian Council has recorded great merit for him. As long as he comes back, he will be rewarded."
When Elder Huimin said this, she suddenly felt someone not far away cast a fierce glance at her. When she turned her head, she found that it was Zhenren Jie Su, and she couldn't help but be startled.
"Sister, today is Christmas Eve. Do you and I, Brother Long, have any plans today?"
The gossip factor in Lin Xiao's heart became active again.
Of course, no one in this world knew that Byakuya had no ill will, but Erina Nakiri really felt the malice from Byakuya.
Ye came to the classroom of Class 2 next door. He found that the classroom of Class 2 was almost exactly the same as the classroom of his own class. Similarly, when Yaji observed the footprints, the monster suddenly appeared at the back door, then walked around in the classroom and disappeared outside the back door.
Lin Siyu's heart skipped a beat and she subconsciously let go of her hand. When she realized what she was doing, Du Yilong had strode away without stopping.
High Priest Ningye had a complicated look in his eyes, and he said slowly: "Okay, then I'll give you a chance!"
